## Use this case

```python
import pytest


@pytest.mark.geocase_case("multipoint_geopackage_baseline")
def test_multipoint_geopackage_baseline(geocase_case) -> None:
    data = geocase_case.load()
    assert data is not None
```

## What this case checks

Provide a canonical multipoint encoded as a GeoPackage so format-specific loader behavior can be compared directly against the GeoJSON baseline.

## Risk types covered

- [`format_comparison`](../risk/format-comparison.md)

| Assertion | Expected |

| `expect_loadable` | yes |
| `expect_valid_geometry` | yes |
| `expect_crs` | yes |
| `expected_epsg` | `4326` |
| `expected_geometry_types` | `MultiPoint` |
